ja: • 古代進が艦長を務める「ゆうなぎ」のほか、「第８ガミラシア奪還作戦に参加した地球連邦宇宙戦艦がセットで登場。
• 劇中に登場!する「ゆうなぎ」のカラー&マーキングを再現!
• 別売りの1/1000 アンドロメダと一緒に並べて、艦隊航行シーンを再現!
en: • In addition to the Yuunagi, which is captained by Susumu Kodai, the Earth Federation space battleship that participated in the 8th Garmirasia recapture operation is also available as a set.
• Reproduce the color and markings of "Yunagi" that appears in the movie!
• Reproduce the fleet navigation scene by lining up with the 1/1000 Andromeda (sold separately)!
